name: Greed-extreme continuation gated by low realized vol (orderly herding, ride)
rationale: MECHANISM: variant of greed-continuation that swaps the trend gauge — instead of adx, it requires strong positive momentum (ret_Nd) plus LOW realized volatility (vol_realized below a fitted ceiling). The thesis is that greed inside an ORDERLY, low-vol advance is sustainable herding (the crowd calmly bids), whereas greed inside a high-vol blowoff is a distribution top; conditioning on calm vol keeps us in the reinforcing phase and out of the parabolic exhaustion. Long continuation; exit when momentum fades or vol spikes through a fitted level, or stop/TP/time. DISCONFIRMER: compare to the adx-gated continuation — if the low-vol gate selects the same trades, it is redundant; keep only if the vol condition improves OOS DSR by dodging blowoff tops. Kill if it underperforms plain momentum without the greed gate (sentiment adds nothing).
catalyst: extreme greed in an orderly low-volatility uptrend
